name: Band Wipe
description: Alternating bands wipe in from opposite sides together and interleave like fingers, while both clips stay still. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: vertical
params.description: Cut the frame into columns that wipe up and down instead of rows that wipe sideways

params.name: smoothness
params.description: Softness of the bands' leading edges

params.name: stagger
params.description: Delay between the first and the last band, so they cascade from the top (or the left)
